verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an official hosted remote MCP server and an official local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck in the motherduckdb GitHub org). Agents get read-only and read-write SQL (query_rw), schema exploration, and Guides for org context, with a read-only restriction option. A getting-started guide with example prompts is provided, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
